bias.label: Leaning down below 3,903; soft-PPI spike faded

event: Fed's Bowman speaks today, Fri 13 Nov, at 17:50 SAST (15:50 GMT per MQL5). Gold market closes for the weekend tonight.

bullets.title: PPI came in soft
bullets.text: October PPI rose 0.3% m/m against 0.4% expected, but the yearly rate of 6.5% is the highest since November 2022 (Kitco, FinanceFeeds).

bullets.title: Spike then fade
bullets.text: Gold jumped about 26 dollars to 3,906 right after PPI, then fell back to 3,881 within 30 minutes, with a low of 3,873 (MQL5).

bullets.title: Still near lows
bullets.text: Price is about 3,885, up a little on the day but close to Thursday's 13-month low of 3,852 (MQL5, Kitco).

bullets.title: Yields above 5%
bullets.text: Kitco has the US 10-year yield near 5.13% and the dollar index above 103, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: Before PPI, futures priced about 89% odds of a December quarter-point hike and 11% of a half-point hike (Kitco); FXStreet's half-point figure was 14.5%, so the exact odds are UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Iran and oil
bullets.text: Kitco cites a US naval blockade of Iran, Hormuz tension and Brent near 95.5 dollars, which can give gold sudden safe-haven lifts.

bullets.title: Weekend gap risk
bullets.text: Gold closes tonight for the weekend, so a trade held over Saturday and Sunday can open far from your stop on Monday.

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,852-3,856 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,852-3,856, only after a dip that holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping to the 3,852 low and a 15M close back up out of the zone.
A 1H higher low inside the zone, not a fast slice through it.
US yields easing after the soft PPI, or a calm tone from Bowman.
Take some profit at 3,873 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying just because PPI was soft. The spike already failed once at 3,906.
Bowman at 17:50 SAST can push yields up and send gold through 3,852.
Holding over the weekend. Close it before the Friday close if it is not at target.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

look: Price bouncing back up to 3,900-3,906 and stalling there again.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close near 3,903.
Yields staying above 5% and the dollar above 103.
Take some profit at 3,873 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling in the middle at 3,885, just above 3,870-3,875 support. Wait for the retest of 3,903.
